nodes.label: Fault F21.1 — Janak identity fails on scf_occ total energy
Latter tail contamination of banked dSCF energies
nodes.rationale: Eigenvalues come from V_tailed = min(V_HFS,-1/r) while Etot subtracts Hartree/exchange integrals built from the UNTAILED potentials, so Etot carries a negative term growing with occupation q. That makes D = Etot(1)-Etot(0) too negative and forces J-D > 0 — the observed sign, systematic in the object rather than in the rows.
